findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 1 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 101 questions numbered 1-101; by section: 1.1 4, 1.1.1 6, 1.1.2 7, 1.1.3 5, 1.1.4 7, 1.1.5 7, 1.2 4, 1.2.1 6, u-complex-polynomials-as-a-product-of-linear-factors 7, 1.3.1 4, 1.4 4, 1.4.1 7, 1.5 3, 1.5.1 4, u-polar-coordinates-system 5, 1.4.1~2 8, 1.3.3 7, u-complex-numbers-in-the-real-world-voltage-current-and-resist 6. Covers every section of Unit 1 in book order (1.1 to 1.7: complex numbers, conjugate, operations, ordered pairs, field properties and division, Argand diagram and modulus, equality, square roots, polynomial factorization, completing the square, cube and fourth roots of unity, polar coordinates, polar form and principal argument, operations in polar form, impedance and the cryptography idea). Every key and explanation was checked by computation in Python (sympy); none repeats an exercise question or a book example. Book corrections followed: conjugate of 5 - 4i is 5 + 4i, cube roots (-1 +/- sqrt(3) i)/2, roots 2 +/- i in Example 9, r sin(theta) for the imaginary part in Example 12, reactance (not resistance) for X_L and X_C.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
